account.preferencesSummary: Interface language, my languages and learning preferences
account.modelsSummary: Service status, usage and custom providers
account.dataSummary: Connection status, local data and backups
account.backupSummary: Export an encrypted backup or restore one
account.storageSummary: Inspect and clear data in this browser
account.localSync: Saved locally; cloud sync is not enabled
account.agentSummary: Let Codex and other Agents add confirmed information to this semantic world
account.agentSignInRequired: Sign in and connect online services before connecting an external Agent.
account.agentConnectionNote: The Agent can only submit Context–Expression–Sense. It cannot read your semantic world and does not use the browser extension. Complete, confirmed triples are added directly; material with missing facts goes to the Inbox.
account.agentSetupOnce: The setup code is shown only here and expires at {{date}}. The installer obtains the long-lived credential directly, so it is never included in the copied command.
account.agentRevokeConfirm: Revoke “{{label}}”? That Agent will immediately lose submission access.
account.agentRunCommand: Run the command in a terminal on the computer with that Agent. The installer can safely retry after a partial local failure. Restart the Agent when it finishes.
account.agentFailed: Agent connections are temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
account.agentEvent_setup_created: Created a one-time setup code for {{label}}
account.agentEvent_replaced: Replaced the {{label}} connection through a new install

localWeb.cloudNote: Learning history is saved locally for this account and synced with the server.
localWeb.localNote: Content and learning progress are saved in this browser first. Check that account sync has finished before clearing website data.
localWeb.controls: Export and account deletion are not available yet.
localWeb.pendingLogout: Sync pending changes before signing out.
localWeb.privacy: Personal content is saved for your account. Sync pending changes before clearing website data. Permission to use source content can be revoked on the relevant meaning.
localWeb.offlineFailed: Offline setup failed. Your content is safe; reconnect and reopen the app to try again.

account.title: Account & settings
account.identityNote: Learning and content are saved in this browser. Cross-device sync is not available yet.
account.languagesNote: Target languages, default support languages, and the active route
account.learningNote: Learning method and daily new meanings
account.storageNote: Estimated browser storage; excludes the local content library and downloaded media.
account.controls: Sign-in, cloud sync, data export and deletion will be available when account services are connected.
account.aboutText: Start with a specific meaning, connect it with an expression, and build familiarity through learning and review.
account.privacyText: This is a local preview. Clearing website data removes the learning progress and personal content saved here. Online resources such as dictionaries still make network requests. A formal privacy policy is not available yet.

cloudSync.title: Account sync
cloudSync.pending: Local changes are waiting to sync
cloudSync.offline: Saved offline. Sync will resume when connected.
cloudSync.conflict: Some changes conflict. Both versions are preserved. Export a backup and contact support to resolve them.
cloudSync.failed: Sync did not finish. Your local data is still saved. Check the connection and retry.
cloudSync.attention: Automatic retries have stopped. Your local data is still saved. Retry manually or contact support if the problem continues.
cloudSync.incompatible: The cloud data uses an incompatible legacy sync format. Automatic retries have stopped and local data is unchanged. Contact support to reset the cloud copy.
cloudSync.openFailed: Could not restore account data. Check the connection and retry.
cloudSync.identity: This browser and the cloud contain different libraries. Both are preserved. Export a backup and contact support.
